_readme: Packages authorized to run install scripts (preinstall / install / postinstall hooks). Enumerated from package-lock.json 'hasInstallScript' field on 2026-09-25. See scripts/verify-supply-chain.cjs check #5. If a new dep is added that runs install scripts, the build fails until you review + add it here (or drop the dep). This is the programmatic replacement for the npm 11 install-scripts CLI warning that .npmrc loglevel=error hides.
